title: multipart action
description: Wraps the body in a multipart/form-data body, to post it as a form: a part named fname holds the body, followed by the text fields of formFields.

fname.title: Field name
fname.description: Name of the part that holds the body

formFields.title: Form fields
formFields.description: JSON object of extra text fields (name: value); "" for none

contentType.title: Content-Type
contentType.description: Accepted for compatibility; the body is always multipart/form-data
